tour.name: Western Bhutan Valleys
tour.summary: A short tour of the western valleys of Bhutan: Paro, Thimphu and Punakha, with the hike to Taktsang Monastery.
tour.itineraries:
Day 1: Arrive at Paro airport and drive to the hotel. In the afternoon visit Rinpung Dzong and the National Museum above the town, then walk through the old market street.
Day 2: Hike to Taktsang Monastery, the Tiger's Nest, which clings to a cliff above the Paro valley. Lunch at the cafeteria viewpoint, then return to the valley floor.
Day 3: Drive over Dochula Pass to Punakha. Visit Punakha Dzong at the meeting of two rivers and walk across the suspension bridge before the evening.
Day 4: Drive back to Paro along the river road and transfer to the airport for the departure flight.
